Show that your robot can display an emoticon expression on the LCD for 2 seconds.
1. o_o

Hint:
1. Set display type to On for Second.
2. Use lowercase letter o

(Using Repeat loop) Show that your robot can display an emoticon expression that blinks for 0.5 second at every 2 seconds interval and it does this 10 times.

2. -_-

 

Hint:
1. Set display type to On for Second.
2. Use lowercase letter o
3. Repeat # time loop.

Show that your robot can display an large emoticon expression on the LCD screen for 3 seconds. This emoticon expression should occupy 2 rows

1. O O _ Hint: 1. Set display type to On for Second. 2. Use uppercase letter O
